title: Add end-to-end Codex WebSocket transport
description: Add Codex WebSocket ingress and route-v1 relay in sub2api plus native official-Codex WebSocket egress and account scheduling in Aether, including TLS fingerprint parity, generation fences, bounded backpressure, billing and authorization enforcement, usage observability, performance gates, and production rollout documentation.

sub2api to Aether direct WebSocket route-v1 relay without account scheduling ownership
Aether official-Codex-only native WebSocket connector with TLS fingerprint profile parity
Aether account scheduling, handshake failover, generation fencing, and post-write replay prevention
bounded concurrency, usage settlement, moderation, authorization, billing, and quota enforcement
WebSocket usage observability and compatibility-safe administration controls
performance, concurrency, regression, real Codex chain, and production-readiness review
notes: 2026-07-18 local Codex WebSocket chain completed. Both Vite WebSocket proxy hops, Aether route-v1 routing and authentication, Relay multi-turn terminal/control/close semantics, Aether account scheduling fences, and quota concurrency were verified. Three real codex-cli requests through http://localhost:7301/v1 returned WS_LIVE_1, WS_LIVE_2, and WS_LIVE_3 without HTTPS fallback, 1011, relay, proxy, or settlement errors. Aether codex_ws passed 107/107, quota concurrency 10/10, and orchestration 117/117 with isolated Redis 8.2.0. Release workflows completed successfully. No production deployment was performed.
